general.llm_summary: Today's discovery skews toward company-specific catalysts rather than a single broad macro tape: healthcare AI/digital health, precision medicine, defense autonomy, and cash-flow durability produced the cleanest positive signals. The strongest opportunity cluster is GMED and TLX, while ONDS has upside catalysts but mixed evidence because growth headlines sit beside wider-loss and insider-sale concerns. The main risks are AI-driven contract pressure in IT services, Flutter's lowered outlook and CEO transition, and data-quality noise around MU where the cited bullish item appears to reference Howmet rather than Micron.

top_opportunities.why: Highest-confidence direct catalyst: acquisition of Higgs Boson Health adds AI-driven digital healthcare capabilities to Globus Medical.
Multiple aligned positives: return to profitability, FY2026 revenue guidance of $950-$970 million, Wedbush Outperform reiteration, and sharply higher first-half profit/EBITDA.
Guidance for about $18 billion of 2026 free cash flow supports the dividend coverage and buyback narrative.

top_risks.why: Reuters-reported AI pressure on Indian IT services points to shorter contracts, outcome-based pricing, and some work moving in-house.
Lowered outlook, CEO transition, and analyst concern around the next growth engine create a near-term credibility overhang.
Despite revenue, guidance, and Navy-contract positives, losses widened and insider-sale concerns make the signal mixed rather than cleanly bullish.
